a1_row_base.note: Wherever a cell is written as TEXT (A1 notation: map keys of comments and hyperlinks, formula text, reference text) the row number is ONE-based and the column is letters, A = column index 0.

alignment_bytes.note: Payload sections of envelope binaries start on this boundary.

angle_unit.note: Text rotation is in degrees, counter-clockwise positive.

cell_index_base.note: Every numeric row and column index (binary sections, {row, col} objects, row and column map keys, break and title lists) is ZERO-based: the cell written A1 is row 0, column 0.

color_rgb_packing.note: An RGB colour is one integer: red*65536 + green*256 + blue, each 0..255.

color_space.note: Every colour value and every picture is sRGB.

csv_field_separator.note: Fields of the preview CSV are separated by `,`.

csv_quote.note: A field containing `,`, `"`, CR or LF is wrapped in `"`, each `"` inside it doubled.

csv_record_terminator.note: Every row of the preview CSV ends with one U+000A.

date_1900_fictitious_leap_day_serial.note: Date system D1900: serial 60 is 1900-02-29, a day that did not exist (kept for compatibility with older spreadsheets). Serials 1..59 are therefore one day LATER than 1899-12-30 + serial.

date_1900_serial_of_1900_03_01.note: Date system D1900: serial 61 is 1900-03-01; for every serial n >= 61, date = 1899-12-30 + n days.

date_1904_serial_of_1904_01_01.note: Date system D1904: serial 0 is 1904-01-01; date = 1904-01-01 + n days.

date_serial_unit.note: A date is a NUMBER of days; its fractional part is the time of day (0.25 = 06:00:00). No time zone is implied.

endianness.note: Every envelope binary is little-endian. MessagePack header integers inside an envelope are big-endian by MessagePack's own definition (spec/layouts/ENVELOPE.layout.txt section 4).

formula_array_row_separator.note: In an array constant `{1,2;3,4}` rows are separated by `;` and the elements of a row by `,`.

formula_decimal_separator.note: The decimal point in a number literal is `.` (U+002E).

formula_grammar.note: Formula text is the spreadsheet formula language in A1 reference style with ENGLISH function names in upper case (SUM, VLOOKUP), as written in an en-US spreadsheet.

formula_leading_equals.note: Stored formula text does NOT begin with `=` (one field says otherwise and says so: a pivot calculated field).

hash_algorithm.note: Every files[].sha256, every input_hash, license.sha256, and spec_sha256.

length_unit.note: Column widths, row heights, anchor offsets and sizes, font sizes and line widths are in points.

number_type.note: Every numeric cell value is an IEEE-754 binary64, stored bit-exact.

preview_pixel_origin.note: Pixel row 0 of the preview is the top row.

preview_sample_format.note: The preview PNG is 8 bits per channel, red-green-blue, no alpha.

signature_algorithm.note: SIGNATURE.json only. Refusing it is the 'unverified' state, not damage.

text_encoding.note: Every text and JSON payload, INCLUDING MANIFEST.json - which is why the scope is container.

theme_tint_scale.note: A theme colour's tint is in thousandths, -1000..1000.

y_axis_direction.note: Rows, anchor offsets and pixel rows grow downwards; x grows to the right.

note: The machine-readable convention to node-type map of profile spreadsheet/1 (SPEC.md section 10.2, ruling S-17). The convention set is a property of the PROFILE, not of the reader (S-25): check these and no others.
